lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace E]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (mu : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ),
  Differentiable ℝ f →
    ∀ {M : ℝ},
      (∀ᵐ (x : E) ∂mu, |f x| ≤ M) →
        Integrable (fun x => ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ^ 2) mu →
          (∀ᶠ (e : ℝ) in 𝓝 0, Integrable (fun x => ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => √(1 + e * f y)) x‖ ^ 2) mu) ∧
            Tendsto (fun e => (∫ (x : E), ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => √(1 + e * f y)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂mu) / e ^ 2) (𝓝[≠] 0)
              (𝓝 ((∫ (x : E), ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ^ 2 ∂mu) / 4))
approved_definition_context: fderiv ℝ g x is the totalized Frechet derivative, a continuous real linear map; its norm is the operator norm. Differentiable ℝ f means genuine differentiability at every point.
Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square root with its totalized value for negative inputs. A real Bochner integral has totalized value zero when not integrable.
Integrable includes a.e. strong measurability and finite integral norm. The notation ∀ᵐ x ∂mu means almost everywhere with respect to mu.
The ordinary real neighborhood filter 𝓝 0 includes zero and both signs. The punctured filter 𝓝[≠] 0 excludes zero and allows both signs. ∀ᶠ denotes eventual truth in its displayed filter.
OpensMeasurableSpace means open sets of the norm topology are measurable. The statement does not postulate a Borel identity or finite total measure.
